WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-97.811924 46.398537, -97.812405 46.398537, -97.814204 46.398526, -97.814829 46.398527, -97.81709 46.398531, -97.818105 46.398533, -97.818074 46.404751, -97.816916 46.404697, -97.816998 46.406186, -97.814836 46.406192, -97.811764 46.406189, -97.811726 46.404475, -97.811924 46.398537))', 4326) AS g
),
buffered_region AS (
  SELECT
    g,
    ST_Buffer(g::geography, 100)::geometry AS g_buffer
  FROM region
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g_buffer)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN buffered_region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g_buffer)
),
slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
region_slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(s.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM slope s, buffered_region r
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(rast, 1, TRUE)).max AS slope
FROM region_slope;
